contract.traceability: Reference `ref` (TestRail case id, e.g. C4099911) in each automated test so a result maps back to its case.
contract.markers: Mirror device + feature as pytest markers; add @pytest.mark.destructive where destructive is true (deselected by default).
contract.cross_check: cross_check lists the back-office systems the case asserts — the test must verify the event landed there (CloudFare / MERIT / SmartTrack).
contract.note: automatable/priority are system-test-ops judgements and a starting point; the automation engineer may override with rationale.

gherkin.given: **Given** a Glider PV has ABT/cEMV enabled and is showing the Present screen

steps.when: **WHEN** a valid contactless payment card or device is presented
steps.then:
**THEN** the tap is accepted for the journey
**AND** the success outcome is shown to the passenger

gherkin.expected: A valid contactless tap is accepted with a success outcome. Variation — Visa, Mastercard, mobile wallet.

gherkin.given: **Given** a Glider PV has ABT/cEMV enabled

steps.when: **WHEN** a card that is declined, expired or mis-read is presented
steps.then:
**THEN** the tap is rejected
**AND** the See Driver / decline outcome is shown

gherkin.expected: Declined/errored taps are rejected with the See Driver/decline outcome.

cases.title: ABT — BIN, Deny and Pilot list handling

gherkin.given: **Given** a Glider PV has the BIN, Deny and Pilot lists applied

steps.when: **WHEN** a card on the Deny or BIN list is presented
steps.then: **THEN** the tap is rejected per the list rules

steps.when: **WHEN** a card on the Pilot list is presented
steps.then: **THEN** the tap is handled per the pilot rules

gherkin.expected: Deny/BIN-listed cards are rejected; Pilot-list cards follow the pilot rules.

cases.title: cEMV — tap enablement by route, location and fare

gherkin.given: **Given** a Glider PV uses route-attribute, location and fare checks to enable cEMV

steps.when: **WHEN** the PV is in a context where all checks pass
steps.then: **THEN** cEMV taps are enabled

steps.when: **WHEN** any of the route, location or fare checks fail
steps.then: **THEN** cEMV taps are disabled in that context

gherkin.expected: cEMV is enabled only when route/location/fare checks pass, and disabled otherwise.

gherkin.given: **Given** a Glider PV is on a Tap-On-Only flat-fare route

steps.when: **WHEN** a passenger taps on for a journey
steps.then: **THEN** a flat-fare journey is recorded

steps.when: **WHEN** the same passenger taps multiple times in a day
steps.then: **THEN** the daily tap and duplicate-tap rules are applied

gherkin.expected: TOO flat-fare journeys record correctly; daily and duplicate-tap rules apply.

gherkin.given: **Given** a passenger has tapped a first Glider journey

steps.when: **WHEN** they tap a connecting journey within the transfer window
steps.then: **THEN** the transfer is recognised per the transfer rules

gherkin.expected: Glider transfers are recognised within the transfer window.

cases.title: ABT — end-to-end journey to back office

gherkin.given: **Given** a Glider PV with ABT enabled and back-office comms available

steps.when: **WHEN** a passenger completes an ABT journey
steps.then:
**THEN** the journey is recorded
**AND** the journey is sent to the back office for settlement

gherkin.expected: An ABT journey is recorded and reaches the back office end-to-end.

cases.title: ABT — Pilot List management and validation

gherkin.given: **Given** a Glider PV with cEMV is configured for the Pilot List via TMS

steps.when: **WHEN** a pilot list (pilotlist.zip) is applied to the PV via TMS, including registration mode
steps.then: **THEN** the PV applies the pilot list configuration

steps.when: **WHEN** an EMV card that is included on the Pilot List is presented
steps.then: **THEN** the card is accepted per the pilot rules

steps.when: **WHEN** an EMV card that is NOT on the Pilot List is presented
steps.then: **THEN** the card is handled per the not-included rule

steps.when: **WHEN** the pilot list is exported
steps.then: **THEN** it can be converted from CSV to DAT and downloaded as CSV from Device Log Manager

gherkin.expected: Pilot List TMS config + registration mode apply; included EMV accepted, not-included handled; CSV↔DAT conversion and Device Log Manager CSV download supported.

cases.title: ABT — Deny and BIN list updates

gherkin.given: **Given** a Glider PV with cEMV and back-office comms

steps.when: **WHEN** delta and full Deny/BIN list updates are published
steps.then: **THEN** the PV downloads and applies them, taking the full lists at end of day and deltas on schedule

steps.when: **WHEN** a list download fails
steps.then: **THEN** the PV retries the download and application

steps.when: **WHEN** a card on the Deny or BIN list is presented
steps.then: **THEN** the tap is rejected

steps.when: **WHEN** a card is removed from the list and re-presented
steps.then: **THEN** the tap is accepted

gherkin.expected: Delta + full Deny/BIN updates download/apply (full end-of-day, delta scheduled) with retries; listed cards rejected, removed cards accepted. Pins TIBU-26320 (Deny download fail) and TIBU-25745 (BIN download fail).

cases.title: cEMV — decline reasons and route-type enablement

gherkin.given: **Given** a Glider PV with cEMV

steps.when: **WHEN** a card fails Offline Data Authentication, is an unsupported scheme (e.g. AMEX), is expired, has an invalid BIN, fails the AID check, is a card clash, is on the deny or negative list, or is not read successfully
steps.then: **THEN** the Please Try Again outcome is shown with the corresponding decline reason

steps.when: **WHEN** the route is "Tap On Only (Flat Fare)" or "Tap On Tap Off"
steps.then: **THEN** cEMV taps are enabled for that route type

steps.when: **WHEN** no valid fare is found, the boarding location is outside the configured area, or cEMV is disabled in the Technician Menu
steps.then: **THEN** cEMV taps are disabled

gherkin.expected: cEMV declines on ODA fail / unsupported scheme (AMEX) / expired / invalid BIN / AID fail / card clash / deny or negative list / unread, showing Please Try Again with the reason; enables for Tap-On-Only and Tap-On-Tap-Off route types; disables on no-fare / out-of-area / Technician-Menu-disable.

cases.title: cEMV — JourneyTap audit and alighting-stage derivation

gherkin.given: **Given** a Glider PV with cEMV on a Tap-On-Only route

steps.when: **WHEN** a successful cEMV tap is made
steps.then:
**THEN** the tap is audited as a "JourneyTap" in CloudFare
**AND** the alighting stage is derived from the Furthest Alighting Point file

gherkin.expected: A successful cEMV tap is audited as a JourneyTap, with the alighting stage derived from the Furthest Alighting Point file.

cases.title: cEMV — tap audit content (JourneyTap, stop/stage, direction, payment method)

gherkin.given: **Given** a Glider PV with cEMV on a Tap On Only route

steps.when: **WHEN** a successful cEMV tap is made
steps.then:
**THEN** the tap is audited as a "JourneyTap" in CloudFare
**AND** the audit records both the stop id and the stage id
**AND** the tap direction is audited correctly as IN
**AND** the payment method is audited correctly for the Glider TOO transaction

gherkin.expected: A cEMV TOO tap audits as a JourneyTap with both stop id and stage id, the correct direction (IN, not OUT), and the correct payment method.

cases.title: cEMV — EMV result screens and transaction generation

gherkin.given: **Given** a Glider PV with cEMV

steps.when: **WHEN** a cEMV tap succeeds or fails
steps.then:
**THEN** the correct EMV success or failure screen is shown
**AND** the EMV result screen times out after the configured period rather than persisting

steps.when: **WHEN** a smartcard is presented while an EMV success or failure screen is shown
steps.then: **THEN** the smartcard tap is accepted

steps.when: **WHEN** an EMV tap fails
steps.then: **THEN** a transaction is still generated for the failed tap

steps.when: **WHEN** a card is re-presented for EMV passback
steps.then: **THEN** the correct EMV passback screen is shown

gherkin.expected: EMV success/failure/passback screens are correct and time out (don't persist); smartcards tap on those screens; failed EMV taps still generate a transaction.

gherkin.given: **Given** the PV is showing the Present SmartCard or Barcode screen

steps.when: **WHEN** a valid single-use barcode is presented
steps.then:
**THEN** the barcode is validated
**AND** the validation is recorded in the back office (CloudFare and MERIT)

steps.when: **WHEN** an invalid single-use barcode is presented
steps.then: **THEN** the barcode is rejected with the specific reason shown

cases.title: Barcode — early-morning expiry displays the previous day

gherkin.given: **Given** a technician is in the Technician Menu

steps.then: **THEN** the PV checks the back-office manifest and attempts to send any pending audit records

steps.when: **WHEN** the technician presses Refresh
steps.then: **THEN** the displayed values update to the most recent information

gherkin.expected: The Force Communications page summarises pending audit count, last successful audit send, last manifest attempt, last successful manifest download and pending file count; Call Now triggers a manifest check and audit send; Refresh updates the displayed values.
